headline: Iran fires on 3 ships in the Strait of Hormuz, complicating efforts to resume US-Iran talks
summary: Iran fired on three ships in the Strait of Hormuz, an intensification of its assault on shipping in a waterway crucial to global energy supplies. The attacks complicate efforts to resume US-Iran talks.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil and LNG, so disruptions there quickly affect energy prices.
why_moved: Attacks on commercial shipping in a waterway critical to energy supplies raise supply-risk concerns, and the talks setback removes hopes for de-escalation.
